scope: Schema metadata and aggregate completeness counts only. These are project-level diagnostics, not authorized AI market query results or verified market statistics.

buildings.completion_year.dictionaryDescription: 楼宇建成/预计入市年份，可含季度

building_metrics.total_area.meaning: 季度总面积，不能替代总建筑面积

sourceMetadata.qualification: Database provenance statuses are stored labels, not a new independent verification. A field can have multiple evidence records; record counts are not building counts. This table is outside the existing trusted query source router.

decision.reason: Fields exist, but are absent from current independent AI field grants and reviewed source routing. Existing catalog completion_year mixes market-entry and completion semantics. Do not broaden grants, substitute quarterly total area for GFA, or infer precise dates.

queries.schema: information_schema.columns for explicitly named tables and fields
queries.brochure: count rows/distinct building_id/completion_date; count future dates; positive finite gfa_total/gfa_office; duplicate building_id groups
queries.catalog: count nonempty completion_year; anchored four-digit year and numeric year-month formats; remaining nonempty strings
queries.grants: enabled and valid_until > now(); count and distinct field/capability arrays only
queries.quotes: building_metrics where not coalesce(is_draft,false); positive finite/nonpositive asking_rent counts
queries.provenance: group only by target_table, field_name, verification_status and is_current for the audited fields
